purpose: Prevent future HK law fields from becoming an infinite chain of if/else answer templates.

architecture.fallback_policy: Deterministic prose blocks may stay only as fallback for demo continuity. New fields should add rule decks and verifier tests before any final prose output is exposed.

when_to_use: existing domain tree has no clean doctrine_node_id
landmark case lineage is needed for candidate discovery
required_sequence: verify every case/statute through public LegalRef/HKLII/e-Legislation sources
create paragraph/proposition/source cards only after exact quote/source match
attach to doctrine tree as machine_candidate only
run answer verifier and golden queries
notebooklm_browser_workflow.private_text_policy: Do not copy private/licensed NotebookLM source text into public artifacts.
browser_safety: Use logged-in Chrome/NotebookLM only if user asks or the workflow is blocked without it.
Do not inspect cookies, passwords, account storage or unrelated tabs.
Do not upload private files unless the user explicitly confirms exact files.

must_not: cite a case without public paragraph/source card
add a final-prose composer branch without a rule deck and verifier
